query: For an 84-year-old man: among male ICU patients aged 79–89 with pulmonary embolism, what is the 75th percentile of diagnostic utilization score in first 24h, and how do their ICU LOS and in‑hospital mortality compare to the general ICU population?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY (icu_patients.los + icu_patients.dod) / 2) AS percentile_score, icu_patients.los AS icu_length_of_stay, icu_patients.dod AS in_hospital_death_rate FROM icu_patients;
